title: How register residence fields point at a place
description: CSV keeps diplomatic residence text. Optional structured ref adds place_id + as_of_date (usually the event date) so UI can resolve historical name/jurisdiction.

residence_as_written.description: Diplomatic CSV cell (ex Lank, Ilverich, Lanck, …)

place_id.description: Resolved gazetteer id; null until matched

as_of_date.description: Event date ISO used to pick name/admin rows (baptism_date, marriage_date, …)
